read.thesis: Q3 revenue grew only 2.5% organic cc with non-GAAP margin up to 16.7%, while cash fell 25.5% YTD and the company committed $500M ASR; buybacks rather than supply discipline drive EPS.

triggers.label: FY revenue growth narrowed to 3.5–3.7%
triggers.quote: now expects the year-over-year revenue growth rate to be in the range of 3.5% to 3.7%

triggers.label: $500M ASR and 50% FCF return commitment
triggers.quote: plans to enter a $500 million accelerated share repurchase next week

triggers.label: Q3 organic cc growth only 2.5%
triggers.quote: On an organic constant currency basis, revenues were up 2.5% compared to the third quarter of 2025

guidance.quote: now expects the year-over-year revenue growth rate to be in the range of 3.5% to 3.7%
now expects the year-over-year revenue growth rate on an organic constant currency basis to be in the range of 2.5% to 2.7%
non-GAAP diluted EPS to be in the range of $13.23 to $13.31
The Company expects revenues will be in the range of $1.405 billion to $1.420 billion for the fourth quarter
The Company is committed to returning at least 50% of its free cash flows to shareholders annually from 2027 through 2029.

red_flags.label: Cash down 25.5% YTD; OCF 9M $250M vs $372M
red_flags.quote: Cash provided by operating activities was $250.1 million for the first nine months of 2026, compared to cash provided by operating activities of $372.0 million

red_flags.label: Headcount growth only 1.2% QoQ amid flat revenue
